classBins.note: measurement bins only; they say nothing about fish preference (Biological owns that)
classBins.DRY: no water over the marker (measured depth <= 0 ft)

predictionRule: For a named flat with a reference observation at pool P0 (depth d0, pool from the operator at that hour), the prediction at a later visit with pool P1 is d_pred = d0 + (P1 - P0) using Depth's shift definition; uncertainty sigma_pred = sqrt(sigma_ref_obs^2 + sigma_shift0^2 + sigma_shift1^2) with sigma_ref_obs = 0.25 ft (hand/sonar), and Depth's published uncertaintyFt per visit for the shift components.
shiftCheck: Independent of any reference depth: observed change in depth at a fixed marker between two visits vs the Depth shift difference (shift1 - shift0).

dryRecall.note: reported, not a pass criterion: share of observed DRY markers predicted DRY or TOO_SHALLOW

rules: Thresholds above are frozen. They may not be changed after field outcomes are seen.
Observations are scored on the Depth state generated at the observation time (fingerprint recorded), not recomputed afterwards.
Exclusions need a recorded reason decided before looking at the prediction error (e.g. sonar failure); excluded rows are reported.
Report all lakes, including failures; no lake-level cherry-picking.
A failure of any criterion means effective depth is NOT field-validated, whatever the other results.
